about: THE ONE LOCAL MODEL SERVICE (queue item fold-c-G03). One address, written once, read by node/model_service.py. The shell, the local hub and every other machine ask that module and never type an address of their own. No key or credential belongs in this file. Every base_url must be on this machine or the private network: the resolver refuses anything else, and when no service is enabled it raises instead of reaching for a vendor (a cloud path is a decision behind the approval gate, never a fallback). The one service is the overlord GPU service by the owner's standing words (relayed by CONDUCTOR 061, 2026-11-23: 'not GREYWOLF-dependent'). It is listed as not deployed because its container (queue item W09, CT 105) does not exist yet; the port is llama-swap's default and is a PROPOSAL until W09 lands. Enabling it is a one-word edit by the owner after `model_service.py probe overlord-gpu` answers.

services.needs: W09 (CT 105 on overlord) and oss-3 (llama-swap pilot)
